name: search_bytes
description: Find masked byte signatures in initialized analyzed memory. Hex byte pairs and ?? wildcards are supported; an optional equal-length hex mask selects bits. Bounds are inclusive. Matches are ordered by provider address and never span blocks. Coverage describes this page; reuse the same query with next_cursor to continue. Uninitialized blocks are listed separately. Ghidra only; Hopper is unavailable.

document.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

end.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

mask.description: Hexadecimal mask byte pairs, with optional whitespace between complete pairs; no leading or trailing whitespace. Must contain the same number of bytes as pattern.

pattern.description: Hexadecimal byte pairs or ?? whole-byte wildcards, with optional whitespace between complete pairs; no leading or trailing whitespace. At least one bit must be constrained after applying the mask.

start.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal
